messages.subject: Re: {Suspected Spam} [distance-sampling] how “group” are defined in field investigation?
parts:
A group is an assemblage of animals occurring together and travelling together as a group.  There is no fixed value for distance to consider animals a group; it depends upon the biology of the species.  Certainly animals separated by a kilometre are unlikely to be considered members of the same group.
